VI.description: Drives an open LabVIEW menu with one key: posts WM_KEYDOWN and WM_KEYUP of vk (lParam key lParam - repeat count 1\2C the key's scan code and the extended bit - plus the previous-state and transition bits 0xC0000000 for the key-up) to hWnd\2C the served panel\2C with user32 PostMessageW\2C then waits until LabVIEW has handled them (RemoteVI Wait Input Handled.vi\2C two WM_NULL sent - handled inside the menu's modal loop too). LabVIEW menus take posted keys from the panel window while the menu is open\2C also while a submenu is open\2C and paint the result before that wait returns (measured on LabVIEW 2025\3A VK_DOWN/VK_UP move the highlight by one item\2C skipping separators\2C and wrap around at the ends\3B VK_RIGHT opens the highlighted item's submenu next to its parent\3B VK_RETURN chooses the highlighted item or opens its submenu\3B VK_LEFT closes the deepest submenu\3B a custom popup such as the colour picker takes no keys). Used by RemoteVI Highlight Menu Row.vi\2C RemoteVI Menu Click.vi and RemoteVI Menu Hover.vi. Win32 only\2C no VI Server call\2C so it runs while the menu's modal loop holds LabVIEW's UI thread. An incoming error posts nothing.

FreeLabel.comment: Key down\2C key up\2C wait until handled

Control.description: The served panel window (it holds the mouse capture while a LabVIEW menu is open).
Virtual-key code\2C e.g. 0x28 VK_DOWN\2C 0x26 VK_UP\2C 0x27 VK_RIGHT\2C 0x25 VK_LEFT\2C 0x0D VK_RETURN.
lParam of the key-down\3A 1 + scan code * 0x10000 (+ 0x1000000 for an extended key such as the arrows).
